title: Total US robocalls per year, 2016 vs. 2024

source.name: YouMail Robocall Index -- Annual Robocall Reports

notes: Total US robocall volume per year, YouMail Robocall Index: 29.3 billion in 2016 (the first full year YouMail tracked annual volume) vs. 52.8 billion in 2024 -- roughly 200 robocalls for every US adult that year.
